name: Hallea
bio: Hallea grew up exploring the fields and halls of the monastery by her home, never suspecting the great destiny looming over her - to heal the Eternal Empire and Amara itself. Now grown, she wanders the world, fighting where she must and healing what she can.

effects.label: ATK Down
effects.description: Decreases the recipient's Attack stat by the indicated percentage.

effects.label: Shield
effects.description: Gives the recipient a HP Shield. All damage the recipient takes will be subtracted from the Shield first, before their HP.Each Skill can only cast one Shield at a time on each recipient.
